items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Freddie Webster was there. ... I remember Freddie Webster and myself we, we learned Moose the Mooche off the record.

ctx.x: ...from Tulsa. Um I stayed with him about a year, maybe all of ’46. And then in ’47 I, I left Ernie and went to Chicago, and Sonny Stitt was there, and we had been friends in Detroit, you know. And uh...for about two years every day uh–of course, I had a wife and two children, but Sonny was living in Chicago–every day we’d get up in the morning and go practice at a saxophone player whose name was Howard Martin–who was a composer, saxophonist–myself, Sonny and a drummer called Buddy Butler.
